newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia farmers' grain sales down 7 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Russia farmers' grain sales down 7 pct in 1996.

text.p: Russian farmers sold 26.3 million tonnes of grain in 1996, seven percent less than in 1995, Russian State Statistics Committee figures showed on Friday.

Russia's 1996 net grain harvest was 69.3 million tonnes, up from 63.4 million tonnes in 1995. Farmers only sell part of their production, using the remainder for seed, feeding livestock and other needs.

Government entities purchased 8.6 million tonnes of the total farmer sales, a 12 percent drop from last year, and the federal fund, a stockpile of strategic grain reserves, bought a bare 415,000 tonnes, nine percent of its planned buys.
Farmers and agricultural enterprise held 23 million tonnes of grain in reserves at the beginning of this year, down from 26.7 million tonnes on December 1, 1996.
Bread-quality wheat stocks stood at two million tonnes.
